title: Explainable AI for Academic Literature Review
abstract: This study explores explainable AI methods for literature review automation using knowledge graphs and natural language processing. The paper reports promising results but highlights future work on human-centered evaluation and broader benchmark datasets.

title: Graph Mining for Doctoral Research Discovery
abstract: The paper proposes a graph mining approach to organize papers, authors, methods, and datasets. The study uses a single dataset and notes that external validity requires more evaluation across disciplines.
